name: Panaracer RiBMo ProTite tire - 25mm
description:
Made popular by messengers and street smashers during the fixed gear boom of the late 2000s due to it's durability and ability to handle the sickest fixie skids without sacrificing performance and handling, the RiBMo ProTite boldly urges you to "Ride Bicycle More"!
The tread profile features a steeper "All Contact" angle from the center of the tire to the bead for superb grip and stability when leaning into corners. Inverted grooves offer tread flex for added grip and proper syphoning in wet and inclement conditions, while Panaracer's Mile Cruncher tread compound adds exceptional durability yet without causing a harsh ride.
For Durability, the RiBMo has a an 800D polyamide cord casing that is almost twice as strong conventional tire casings, and has excellent rigidity to decrease pinch flats while making catastrophic sidewall cuts a thing of the past.

name: Vittoria RideArmor G2.0 TLR tire - 26mm
spec_notes: 100 TPI Nylon casing for ultimate durability & comfort
description:
The RideArmor G2.0 TLR Road Tire is Vittoria's toughest road tire available.
Featuring a 100tpi nylon casing, bead-to-bead puncture protection belt, additional sidewall layers, and bead shield layers contribute to enhanced durability and puncture protection for the harshest of road and weather conditions, this all-season tire delivers dependable durability and long wear-life, with a focus on comfort and grip across all asphalt and weather conditions.
RideArmor also boasts the Graphene + Silica compound, Vittoria's cutting-edge formulation for fast-rolling road tire applications, originally featured only in Vittoria's top-tier road tires like the Corsa Pro series.
The slick tread design minimizes rolling resistance and maximizes speed, providing a contemporary aesthetic when paired with the black/copper cord color of the sidewalls.

name: Panaracer GravelKing SK Plus tire - 30mm / black
spec_notes: ZSG (Zero Slip Grip) natural rubber compound provides consistent performance through a wide range of temperatures and wears well
description:
The GravelKing SK Plus is a super tough, high performance tire that features a semi-knobby tread pattern with a super tough puncture belt ideal for aggressive gravel and dirt roads.
Panaracer's ZSG (Zero Slip Grip) Compound is crafted from a proprietary material to ensure remarkable resistance to temperature and weather fluctuations. This consistent rubber performance provides lower rolling resistance and improved grip across a spectrum of temperatures, and tire resilience is increased with a dual layer of bead-to-bead TuffTex material, providing additional puncture resistance.
Available in all black or black with brown sidewalls.

name: Continental Grand Prix 5000 All Season TR tire - black/cream / 25mm
spec_notes: Spider silk-like Vectran puncture protection has an extremely high tear resistance at a very low weight
description:
Handmade in Germany, Continental's Grand Prix 5000 All Season TR tires are ready to go the extra mile, featuring robust tubeless ready carcass construction to protect against damage and penetration from foreign objects, and providing confidence in all weather conditions.
Vectran Breaker is spun from liquid crystal-polymer to create a multiple-thread thermoplastic yarn. This partially crystalline fabric is more cut-resistant than aramid and its tensile strength is five times higher than that of steel. A Vectran Breaker is lighter, more flexible and effective against cuts than a comparable nylon breaker, without affecting rolling resistance.
Lazer Grip delivers more cornering traction from day one requiring no break-in time thanks to its micro profile structure (ie: tiny laser-drilled holes) that reach over the shoulder of the tire.
Available in all black or with a cream-colored sidewall.
